facts.statement: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism is a movement disorder that starts in adulthood and mostly affects men of Filipino heritage.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The disorder is caused by a specific genetic insertion in the TAF1 gene.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study created a mouse model with a hybrid gene that includes the human genetic mutation responsible for the disease.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Male mice with the activated gene showed severe movement problems and shrinkage of the striatum, similar to human symptoms.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Tests on the mice's brains showed fewer cells that make myelin and damage to the myelin itself.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Brain tissue from people who had the disease also showed similar damage to myelin, including in the medial prefrontal cortex.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The findings suggest that problems with myelin-producing cells and the loss of myelin are major factors in the disease.
facts.subject: other
